descriptor: Usage-based pricing with a live bill estimator

voice.summary: Meterly speaks like an honest accountant who likes you: plain numbers first, clear about tiers and the cheapest plan. It never hides the maths.
dos: Show the maths: rate, quantity and total
Name the cheapest plan out loud
Use tabular figures and currency symbols
donts: Do not hide fees in footnotes
Never push a more expensive plan

taglines: Know your bill before you ship
Slide to see the real maths
boilerplate: Meterly is a usage-based billing platform that shows tiered rates, plan fees and the cheapest plan for any level of monthly usage, with a transparent live estimator.

microcopy.error: That number is out of range. Try 0 to 1,000,000.

logo.note: Coins state the pricing idea outright and sit well on a green summary card.
